[{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"TRANSFER INFORMATION","groupId":"c0766f45-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":0,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"MAJOR INFORMATION","groupId":"c2766f45-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"
  1. Students must earn a \"C\" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. ﻿Transfer students interested in the Public Health major who are selected for admission to the university are admitted as pre-majors. To declare the Public Health major, students must meet the following requirements:
  3. Complete the following lower-division pre-major courses with a minimum grade of \"C\" or better: BIO 25, BIO 26, CHEM 6A, and STAT 1. All pre-major courses must be completed prior to declaring the major.
  4. Have a minimum overall GPA of 2.5 and be in good academic standing.
  5. Complete 45 units of transferable coursework.
  6. Foreign Language Graduation Requirement Exemption: Students graduating with a BS in Public Health (all concentrations) will not be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students who change major may be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement.
  7. For additional information, please see: Department of Public Health.
